port.label: Port
port.placeholder: Note: port should not be set for SRV connections

srv.label: SRV Connection
srv.description: Check if using an SRV/seed list connection, i.e. one that begins with 'mongdb+srv://' (if so, the port field should be left empty)

ssl.label: Use SSL
ssl.description: Check to enable SSL/TLS for the connection

allow_insecure.label: Allow Invalid Certificates
allow_insecure.description: Check to bypass verification of certificates during SSL/TLS connections (has no effect for non-SSL/TLS connections)
